nodes.name: Act 6: The Rising Tide
nodes.summary: Sixth act and start of Part Two. After failing to stop Kitava's reawakening the exile flees Oriath and returns to Wraeclast, guided by Sin, who plans to harvest souls for a Dark Ember; the exile faces Tukohama, Abberath, Ryslatha and the Brine King. Town: Lioneye's Watch; monster levels 45-50.

nodes.name: Act 7: Lord and Legion
nodes.summary: Seventh act. The exile lands at the Broken Bridge (Bridge Encampment); Sin asks for Maligaro's soul while Ralakesh possesses Greust and Silk consorts with Arakaali. Monster levels 51-54.

nodes.name: Act 8: Eclipse
nodes.summary: Eighth act. The exile returns to the Sarn Encampment to find Doedre in the sewers while the sun and moon goddesses Solaris and Lunaris awaken and battle. Monster levels 55-60.

nodes.name: Act 9: Reunion
nodes.summary: Ninth act. The exile returns to Highgate, whose waters run red with the dead Beast's blood; Sin's plan is to wake a Dark Ember from the Beast's corpse. Kira/Garukhan, Shakari and the Depraved Trinity are faced. Monster levels 61-64.

nodes.name: Act 10: Return to Oriath
nodes.summary: Tenth and final act. With Lilly Roth's help the exile returns to ruined Oriath, finds Bannon, awakens Innocence and kills Kitava in the Feeding Trough. Monster levels 64-67.

nodes.name: Epilogue
nodes.summary: The post-campaign epilogue: after Kitava's death Lilly Roth offers to sail the exile away ('Toward the Future'); the exile arrives in Karui Shores, where Helena and Commander Kirac introduce the Atlas of Worlds. Earlier versions of the Epilogue were set in rebuilding Oriath.

sources.locator: Overview: 'transition directly into the Epilogue, leading to Karui Shores and The Atlas of Worlds'

nodes.name: The Pantheon
nodes.summary: Pantheon power system introduced by Sin after Tukohama's death: Sin captures the souls of the risen gods the exile kills in Part Two and lends the exile a small portion of their power. The Brine King, Arakaali, Solaris and Lunaris grant major god powers; Tukohama, Abberath, Ryslatha, Ralakesh, Gruthkul, Yugul, Garukhan and Shakari are minor gods.

sources.locator: After Tukohama: Sin introduces the Pantheon
'Sin is able to capture the souls of the Pantheon of gods'
Garukhan is a minor pantheon goddess

nodes.name: Sin
nodes.summary: Thief of Virtue, twin brother of Innocence and creator of the Beast via the Dark Ember seed; in Part Two he guides the exile to harvest the souls of risen gods and Malachai's lieutenants to forge a new Dark Ember and defeat Kitava. Returns in PoE2 as 'the Hooded One'.

sources.locator: Lore, The Beast, In-game interactions, Path of Exile 2
"I am Sin, the Forgotten One." / Act 6: "I am Sin, Thief of Virtue, and it is mine to take what I will from the defeated"

nodes.name: The Dark Ember
nodes.summary: The seed from which Sin grew the Beast beneath Highgate. After the Beast's death Sin plans to rekindle a residue of it from the souls of Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre to give the exile a chance against Kitava.

sources.locator: 'The Beast': Sin planted the Dark Ember beneath Highgate
Sin: "The very seed that brought my Beast into existence. The Dark Ember."

nodes.name: The Beast
nodes.summary: Creature grown by Sin from the Dark Ember to lull the gods into sleep and prevent mortal ascension to godhood; killed by the exile in Act 4, which freed the gods and the souls of Malachai's lieutenants.

chronology.relative: Created by Sin; killed in PoE1 Act 4

nodes.name: Innocence
nodes.summary: Sin's twin brother and a Templar god; hosted by High Templar Avarius, destroyed in Act 5 and in Act 10 resurrected when Bannon sacrifices himself, then destroys Kitava's Horns to help the exile.

sources.locator: Bannon: 'it has the ability to revitalize Innocence into waking fully'
Innocence: "Bone and corruption shall not impede the path of purity!"

nodes.name: High Templar Avarius
nodes.summary: High Templar who served as Innocence's vessel in Act 5; his Staff of Purity is recovered in Act 10 to break Kitava's Horns and revive Innocence in a new host.

sources.locator: Staff of Avarius in the Chamber of Innocence

nodes.name: Kitava, the Insatiable
nodes.summary: Karui god of chaos, hunger and corruption, a cannibal deity who feeds on Oriath; reawakens at the end of Act 5, is the final boss of Acts 5 and 10 and is killed in the Feeding Trough.

sources.locator: Lore: 'Karui god of chaos, hunger, and corruption'; final boss of Act 5 and Act 10

nodes.name: Kitava Reawakens and Defeats the Exile
nodes.summary: At the end of Act 5 the reawakened Kitava cannot be beaten: his beam destroys the Sign of Purity and Sin snatches the exile from his jaws, telling them to take the ship to Lioneye's Watch. This begins Part Two.

sources.locator: "A ship sails for Lioneye's Watch not far from here. Be on it."
Act 5: battle cannot be won; Kitava's beam destroys the Sign of Purity and Sin saves the player

nodes.name: Return to Wraeclast
nodes.summary: The exile arrives at Lioneye's Watch aboard Lilly Roth's ship, and Sin tasks them with harvesting souls to birth the Dark Ember; the Pantheon is later introduced.

nodes.name: Lioneye's Watch
nodes.summary: Coastal refugee town on the Twilight Strand; Act 1 town and, in Part Two, the Act 6 town where Tarkleigh, Bestel, Lilly Roth and Sin await the exile.

sources.locator: Lioneye's Watch is the Act 6 town

nodes.name: The Karui Fortress
nodes.summary: Act 6 area containing Tukohama's Keep, where the Karui war god is fought.

nodes.name: Axiom Prison
nodes.summary: Prison complex reached through the Act 6 Ridge; contains Shavronne's Tower, where Shavronne's spirit is killed for Sin.

sources.locator: Shavronne in her tower in the Prison

nodes.name: Prisoner's Gate (Act 6)
nodes.summary: Act 6 area with the side area Valley of the Fire Drinker where Abberath is found.

sources.locator: Located in The Valley of the Fire Drinker, side area of Prisoner's Gate

nodes.name: The Wetlands (Act 6)
nodes.summary: Act 6 area whose side area The Spawning Ground holds Ryslatha.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Spawning Grounds in The Wetlands

nodes.name: The Brine King's Reef
nodes.summary: Blood-reef boss area at the end of Act 6, reached by Weylam Roth's ship the Black Crest, summoned with the Black Flag at the Beacon.

nodes.name: Tsoatha
nodes.summary: Ancient sunken city, domain of the Brine King; Lilly Roth wants to plunder it after his death.

sources.locator: Lilly: 'his sunken domain, the ancient city of Tsoatha'

nodes.name: The Bridge Encampment
nodes.summary: Act 7 town on the broken bridge once ruled by Kraityn, now home to Yeena, Helena, Eramir and Weylam Roth's ghost.

nodes.name: The Chamber of Sins
nodes.summary: Inquisitor Maligaro's laboratory in Phrecia, with a secret passage to the Den.

nodes.name: The Forest Encampment
nodes.summary: Former Azmeri/exile village taken over by Ralakesh through Greust; located between the Ashen Fields and the Northern Forest in Act 7.

sources.locator: Ralakesh is located in The Forest Encampment

nodes.name: The Vaal City
nodes.summary: Vaal city risen from the depths in Act 7, accessed via the Causeway; contains Arakaali's Temple of Decay.

sources.locator: Yeena in The Vaal City near Arakaali's temple
city has risen from the depths

nodes.name: The Temple of Decay
nodes.summary: Arakaali's temple in the Vaal City where Silk is lost and Arakaali is killed.

sources.locator: Kill Arakaali at the heart of the Temple of Decay

nodes.name: The Sarn Encampment
nodes.summary: Act 8 town amid the ruins of Sarn; home of Hargan, Clarissa and Maramoa.

nodes.name: Doedre's Cesspool
nodes.summary: Sewer area of the Toxic Conduits in Sarn where Doedre is killed in the Cauldron.

sources.locator: Doedre's Cesspool contains The Cauldron boss arena

nodes.name: The Harbour Bridge
nodes.summary: Sarn bridge with the Sky Shrine where Solaris and Lunaris are summoned and killed.

sources.locator: Sky Shrine in the center of The Harbour Bridge

nodes.name: The Solaris Temple
nodes.summary: Sarn temple holding the Sun Orb, guarded by the exile 'Dawn'.

sources.locator: Maramoa on The Dawn and the Sun Orb

nodes.name: The Lunaris Temple
nodes.summary: Sarn temple holding the Moon Orb, guarded by the exile 'Dusk'.

sources.locator: Maramoa on The Dusk and the Moon Orb

nodes.name: The High Gardens
nodes.summary: Act 8 gardens associated with Izaro, where Yugul lurks.

nodes.name: The Quay
nodes.summary: Sarn dockside where Clarissa's failed resurrection of Tolman takes place.

nodes.name: The Bath House
nodes.summary: Sarn area where Hector Titucius guards the Wings of Vastiri.

nodes.name: Highgate
nodes.summary: Mining town built over the Beast's corpse; Act 9 town whose waters run red with the Beast's blood. Maraketh Irasha, Tasuni and relic hunters Petarus and Vanja live here.

nodes.name: The Vastiri Desert
nodes.summary: Maraketh desert east of Highgate with the oasis shielded by Shakari's sandstorm.

nodes.name: The Oasis
nodes.summary: Hidden oasis where Shakari rebuilds her army; she is fought in the Sand Pit.

nodes.name: The Quarry
nodes.summary: Act 9 area with a side area for Garukhan and the blood pools around the Lesion where Sin burns a way into the Beast.

nodes.name: The Belly of the Beast / Rotting Core (Act 9)
nodes.summary: Interior of the Beast's corpse; the Black Core / Rotting Core is where the Depraved Trinity is fought.

nodes.name: Oriath
nodes.summary: Capital of the Templar Theocracy; fallen to Kitava's cultists, revisited in Act 10 and rebuilt in the Epilogue.

nodes.name: Oriath Docks
nodes.summary: Act 10 town where Lani, Weylam and Lilly Roth, Divinia and Sin base themselves.

nodes.name: The Cathedral Rooftop (Act 10)
nodes.summary: Rooftop where Bannon holds off Kitava's cultists.

nodes.name: The Desecrated Chambers
nodes.summary: Defiled Chamber of Innocence where Avarius' staff lies; Avarius, Reassembled is fought here.

nodes.name: The Ravaged Square
nodes.summary: Oriath's square where Kitava's Horns block the way to the Canals.

sources.locator: Horns in the Ravaged Oriath Square

nodes.name: The Feeding Trough
nodes.summary: Final area of Act 10 where Kitava feeds and is slain.

sources.locator: You have found Kitava at his Feeding Trough

nodes.name: The Ossuary (Act 10)
nodes.summary: Templar bone-vault in Oriath holding Atziri's Elixir of Allure (love potion in her lover's skull) and the Mortinomicon Exitio Immortalis.

nodes.name: Karui Shores
nodes.summary: Epilogue hub leading to the Atlas of Worlds.

sources.locator: Upon entering Karui Shores talk to Helena

nodes.name: Wraeclast
nodes.summary: Continent of the Path of Exile setting.

nodes.name: Tukohama, Karui God of War
nodes.summary: Karui god of war and minor Pantheon god; the first god the exile kills, in his Keep in the Karui Fortress. Defeating him unlocks the first Pantheon power.

nodes.name: Abberath, the Cloven One
nodes.summary: Goatman god (the Cloven One, Quaffer of Souls) killed in the Valley of the Fire Drinker. Per Bestel, goatmen offer him humans and he eats them 'meat, soul and all'; per Sin he was once Abberath the Scholar King, an alchemist who burned flesh away to drink the life force within, starting with goats. Minor Pantheon god.

sources.locator: Bestel: 'when the goatmen find him a ... human... he eats them'
Act 6 dialogue "Abberath": the Scholar King, Quaffer of Souls

nodes.name: Ryslatha, the Puppet Mistress
nodes.summary: Parasite-queen goddess (a carrion-insect queen covered in parasites) found in the Spawning Ground of the Wetlands. Per Sin she was once a revered matriarch whose children were slaughtered by Tukohama's warriors and who now wants to make everyone's children hers; the Azmeri believed her offspring would one day overwhelm the world. Minor Pantheon god.

sources.locator: Sin on the Azmeri belief about Ryslatha's offspring
Act 6 dialogue "The Puppet Mistress" / "Ryslatha": tribe matriarch, children butchered by Tukohama's warriors

nodes.name: Tsoagoth, the Brine King
nodes.summary: Sea god who turns Nessa into a mermaid to wed her; Act 6 final boss in his reef, whose domain was the city of Tsoatha.

sources.locator: Nessa: 'his majesty could never be satiated on his wedding day by one bride alone'

nodes.name: Ralakesh, Master of a Million Faces
nodes.summary: Vaal god obsessed with control and governance; possesses Greust through a relic in Act 7 and is killed in the Forest Encampment.

nodes.name: Gruthkul, Mother of Despair
nodes.summary: Grieving mother-goddess whose kingdom the Vaal laid waste and whose children were slaughtered; mad with the wish to share her grief, she is killed in the Den of Despair (Dread Thicket). Sin hints that her daughters had plotted against Arakaali, who left her web only when forced to. Minor Pantheon god.

sources.locator: Sin: 'The Vaal laid waste to her kingdom and placed her slaughtered children at her feet.'
Act 7 dialogue "The Mother of Despair": the daughters plotted against Arakaali

nodes.name: Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows
nodes.summary: Vaal spider-goddess of love and death, worshipped by Azmeri artists; consorts with Silk in the Temple of Decay and is killed as Act 7's boss. A relationship with Sin is hinted.

sources.locator: 'lesser relationships with ... Arakaali' (cites PoE2 Arakaali's Lust)

nodes.name: Yugul, Reflection of Terror
nodes.summary: Former Vaal scholar of fear who ascended by terrifying children and Vaal leaders; a maw-god killed in the High Gardens.

nodes.name: Solaris, Eternal Sun
nodes.summary: Azmerian god of the Sun, sister of Lunaris and Viridi, recognised and worshipped by the Eternal Empire; she and Lunaris awaken in Act 8 and are summoned to the Harbour Bridge with the Sun and Moon Orbs and killed. Their flavour texts suggest a possible link to the Maraketh Sekhemas Solerai and Lundara (speculative).

nodes.name: Lunaris, Eternal Moon
nodes.summary: Azmerian god of the Moon, sister of Solaris and Viridi, worshipped by the Eternal Empire; fought alongside Solaris at the Harbour Bridge in Act 8 after the Moon Orb is taken from Dusk.

nodes.name: Garukhan, Queen of the Winds
nodes.summary: Maraketh goddess ('Vulture of the Wastes', Queen of the Winds), wife of Sin and mother of Shakari; in PoE2 she is revealed to have been the mortal Sekhema Orbala. Killed in the Quarry in Act 9 after Kira's attempted sacrifice of Oyun. Minor Pantheon god.

sources.locator: Relationships: Sin was wed to Garukhan

nodes.name: Shakari, Queen of the Sands
nodes.summary: Maraketh scorpion-goddess, daughter of Sin and Garukhan; hides in the Oasis behind a sandstorm rebuilding an ancient army and is killed in the Sand Pit (Act 9). Minor Pantheon god.

sources.locator: Intro: daughter of Garukhan and Sin

nodes.name: Lilly Roth
nodes.summary: Pirate captain and granddaughter of Weylam Roth; her ship brings the exile to Lioneye's Watch (Act 6) and back to Oriath (Act 10). She is the gem vendor, asks the exile to clear the Twilight Strand, to retrieve The Teardrop (map to Tsoatha) and, after Kitava's death, offers to sail the exile away.

sources.locator: Lilly offers to ferry exile to Oriath
Lilly: drowned Oriathans washing ashore after cultists plunder refugee ships
Lilly: Templar privateers took the Teardrop; she and her grandfather plan to sail to Tsoatha

nodes.name: Weylam Roth
nodes.summary: Undead pirate captain of the Black Crest, grandfather of Lilly Roth. Summoned by burning the Black Flag at the Beacon, he is bound to ferry the exile to the Brine King's Reef and on to Phrecia (Act 7); he later appears at the Bridge Encampment and the Oriath docks (Act 10), where he asks for Atziri's Elixir of Allure.

sources.locator: Weylam asks for the Elixir of Allure in the Ossuary

nodes.name: Tarkleigh
nodes.summary: Lioneye's Watch veteran who vendors and gives quests in Act 6, and mourns Nessa.

nodes.name: Bestel
nodes.summary: Lioneye's Watch merchant and amateur poet who asks the exile to kill Abberath.

nodes.name: Nessa
nodes.summary: Oriathan refugee at Lioneye's Watch transformed by the Brine King into a mermaid bride.

nodes.name: Shavronne of Umbra
nodes.summary: One of Malachai's 'Godless Three'; her returned spirit is killed in Shavronne's Tower so Sin can harvest her soul.

nodes.name: Inquisitor Maligaro
nodes.summary: Thaumaturgist and Malachai disciple who worked flesh in the Chamber of Sins; his spirit is killed in Act 7.

nodes.name: Doedre Darktongue
nodes.summary: Third of Malachai's Godless Three; her undead spirit lurks in the Sarn sewers and is killed in Act 8.

nodes.name: Yeena
nodes.summary: Azmeri survivor at the Bridge Encampment who brews Fire Dew to burn open Arakaali's temple.

nodes.name: Helena
nodes.summary: Former Piety expedition member at the Bridge Encampment; tells of Maligaro's secret passage and Greust's memorial.

nodes.name: Eramir
nodes.summary: Scholar from Theopolis (he looked after its museum) living at the Bridge Encampment; he translates the Vaal inscriptions on the relic that washed ashore, identifies the god Ralakesh and asks the exile to end Greust's possession. He fears another theocratic dictatorship.

nodes.name: Greust
nodes.summary: Azmeri-friendly villager of the Forest Encampment (his shrine and necklace follow Azmeri custom) who becomes the avatar of Ralakesh through a washed-up Vaal relic in Act 7; the exile must kill him to force Ralakesh back into the relic. Helena asks that his necklace be laid at the Azmeri shrine in the Northern Forest.

nodes.name: Silk
nodes.summary: Storyteller/artist of the Forest Encampment (Sin notes many Azmeri-descended artists worship Arakaali) who falls for Arakaali in Act 7, calls her his bride and is lost when the exile kills her. Earlier he asks the exile for Black Venom from Maligaro's pet spider (Web of Secrets).

sources.locator: Silk asks for venom from Black Death, Maligaro's pet spider

nodes.name: Maramoa
nodes.summary: Karui exile from Ngamakanui (sentenced 1597 IC) who survives in the Sarn Encampment; he appears in Acts 3 and 8. In Act 8 he warns of the Gemling Legion and of the awakened Solaris and Lunaris, and sends the exile to take the Sun and Moon Orbs from their devotees.

nodes.name: Hargan
nodes.summary: Sarn Encampment trader who points out Doedre and sends the exile after the Wings of Vastiri.

nodes.name: Clarissa
nodes.summary: Sarn survivor (captured with Tolman in Act 3, she escaped) who in Act 8 tries to revive her dead lover Tolman with the Ankh of Eternity; the ritual fails, and she resolves to destroy the Ankh.

nodes.name: Tolman
nodes.summary: Clarissa's lover, captured with her in the Slums and tortured to death by Piety of Theopolis in the Crematorium (Act 3); in Act 8 his zombie returns, and the failed resurrection at the Quay forces the exile to kill him.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Tolman attacks after the ritual fails

nodes.name: Dusk
nodes.summary: Insane exile ('exile-turned-sycophant', in Maramoa's words) who devotes himself to Lunaris and guards the Moon Orb in the Lunaris Temple as the boss Dusk, Harbinger of Lunaris.

sources.locator: Lore: according to Maramoa, "The Dusk" is an exile-turned-sycophant

nodes.name: Dawn
nodes.summary: Insane exile who calls himself 'The Dawn', devotee of Solaris who guards the Sun Orb in the Solaris Temple as the boss Dawn, Harbinger of Solaris.

sources.locator: Lore: once an exile, became insane and a devotee of Solaris

nodes.name: Hector Titucius, Eternal Servant
nodes.summary: One of the Undying: murderer of the Maraketh Sekhema Asenath (the Golden Sekhema), who again guards her Wings of Vastiri in the Bath House; Hargan wants the Wings to ransom back to the Maraketh.

nodes.name: Kira, Servant of Garukhan
nodes.summary: Maraketh warrior who leads a dekhara (warband), obsessed with Garukhan, the 'Vulture of the Wastes'. She kidnaps Sekhema Oyun to sacrifice her, hoping to become a 'Red Sekhema' and wearing the Sekhema Feather; the exile kills her and Garukhan but fails to save Oyun.

nodes.name: Oyun
nodes.summary: Maraketh Sekhema (ruler) of Highgate kidnapped by Kira to be sacrificed to Garukhan; the exile fails to save her.

nodes.name: Tasuni
nodes.summary: Maraketh man of Highgate, brother of Kira, who contends with Irasha for rule of Highgate; he asks the exile to put his sister down, recover the Sekhema Feather and, if possible, return Oyun.

nodes.name: Irasha
nodes.summary: Maraketh akhara of Highgate and rival of Tasuni for rule after Oyun's disappearance. Her twin sister died of a scorpion's sting during the womanhood trial; she asks the exile to kill Shakari and may receive the Sekhema Feather.

nodes.name: Petarus and Vanja
nodes.summary: Relic-hunter duo of Highgate who seek Garukhan's Storm Blade and bottle its storm.

nodes.name: Saresh
nodes.summary: Necromancer (with an undead horde) whom Garukhan fought in the eastern desert, when she lost the Storm Blade - according to the relic hunters Petarus and Vanja's research; nothing else is said about him, and his date is unknown.

sources.locator: Vanja: 'ancient battle against the necromancer Saresh'

nodes.name: Orbala
nodes.summary: Maraketh warrior, known as the Sekhema of Sekhemas, who fought the 'bandit king of Stridevolf'; PoE2 shows she was the mortal identity of Garukhan before her ascension. That she was also the traveller who freed Sin from Innocence's worshippers is only suggested by relic lore (inferred).

sources.locator: Lore: former human Sekhema Orbala (revealed in PoE2)

nodes.name: Lani
nodes.summary: Leader of the rebel encampment at Overseer's Tower (Act 5) and hub NPC of the Oriath Docks in Act 10; she tells how Vilenta betrayed her and Bannon, is fond of Bannon, and rewards the exile after Kitava's fall.

nodes.name: Bannon
nodes.summary: Act 5 vendor and ally of Lani who bears the fire of Ngamahu; rescued by the exile on the Cathedral Rooftop in Act 10, he uses the Staff of Avarius and sacrifices himself to become the host of the resurrected Innocence.

sources.locator: Bannon: 'I will become his host in the fullest sense'

nodes.name: Vilenta
nodes.summary: Traitor who let Kitava's cultists into the Overseer's Tower; later a monster killed in the Control Blocks.

nodes.name: Divinia
nodes.summary: Templar archivist at the Oriath docks who seeks the Mortinomicon.

nodes.name: Kirac
nodes.summary: Oriath officer. In the older Epilogue (v3.9-3.16, 'Picking Up the Pieces', now removed) Officer Kirac sends the exile to the Templar Laboratory to find his brother Baran and learn about Zana; in the current Epilogue Commander Kirac waits in the War Room at Karui Shores and hands the exile the first Map (A Call to Arms).

sources.locator: Karui Shores: Helena directs the player to Commander Kirac in the War Room, who gives a Tier 1 map

nodes.name: Zana
nodes.summary: Master cartographer. In the older Epilogue Kirac blames 'Zana Caeserius' for the disappearance of his brother Baran, and in the Epilogue quest 'Brave New Worlds' (v3.1, since marked historical) Zana gives maps through portals; she belongs mainly to the Atlas/Master storylines of other domains.

nodes.name: Malachai, the Nightmare
nodes.summary: Act 4 boss whose lieutenants Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre are revived and harvested in Part Two.

nodes.name: Staff of Avarius
nodes.summary: Holy staff of High Templar Avarius lying in the desecrated Chamber of Innocence; Bannon says it can break Kitava's Horns but its real power is to revive Innocence, using Bannon as host.

nodes.name: The Storm Blade
nodes.summary: Crystal sword of Garukhan capturing storms; its storm is bottled to disperse Shakari's sandstorm.

nodes.name: Ankh of Eternity
nodes.summary: Artefact said to have power over life and death, placed in a shrine in the Quay by Veruso, Prima Imperialus, at the dawn of the Empire. Clarissa's ritual with it fails; she realises Veruso hid it out of fear over what it did to his wife Chiara and decides to destroy it.

nodes.name: Wings of Vastiri
nodes.summary: Highest symbol of office of the Maraketh Sekhema of Sekhemas, last worn by Asenath before Hector Titucius murdered her; recovered from Hector in the Bath House for Hargan, who plans to sell it back to the Maraketh.

nodes.name: Kishara's Star
nodes.summary: Vaal navigational relic found at the Causeway; Weylam wants to give it to Lilly.

nodes.name: Sekhema Feather
nodes.summary: Symbol of Maraketh leadership; its recipient (Tasuni or Irasha) rules Highgate.

nodes.name: The Teardrop
nodes.summary: Pearl carved with the location of Tsoatha, retrieved from the Reliquary for Lilly.

nodes.name: Clearing the Twilight Strand
nodes.summary: Lilly Roth asks the exile to clear drowned Oriathan undead from the Twilight Strand.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills Tukohama
nodes.summary: The exile obtains the missing eye, reaches Tukohama's Keep and kills the Karui war god; Sin appears and introduces the Pantheon.

nodes.name: Harvesting Shavronne's Soul
nodes.summary: The exile kills Shavronne's spirit in Axiom Prison; Sin harvests her soul for the Dark Ember.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills Abberath
nodes.summary: Bestel's request leads to Abberath's death in the Valley of the Fire Drinker.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills Ryslatha
nodes.summary: The exile destroys the Puppet Mistress's nest on Tarkleigh's request.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills the Brine King
nodes.summary: Following Nessa, the exile sails on the Black Crest to the reef and kills the Brine King, unlocking Act 7.

nodes.name: Ralakesh and Greust
nodes.summary: The exile kills the possessed Greust to drive Ralakesh back into the relic.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills Gruthkul
nodes.summary: Sin sends the exile into the Dread Thicket to kill the grieving goddess.

nodes.name: Harvesting Maligaro's Soul
nodes.summary: The exile kills Maligaro's essence in his sanctum; Sin gains his soul.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills Arakaali
nodes.summary: The exile burns open Arakaali's temple via Yeena's Fire Dew and kills her, failing to save Silk.

nodes.name: Harvesting Doedre's Soul
nodes.summary: The exile kills Doedre in the Cauldron of the Cesspool; Sin harvests her soul.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills Yugul
nodes.summary: The exile kills the fear-god Yugul in the High Gardens.

nodes.name: Tolman's Failed Resurrection
nodes.summary: Clarissa's ritual with the Ankh fails; the exile must kill the resurrected Tolman.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills Solaris and Lunaris
nodes.summary: With the Sun and Moon Orbs the exile summons and kills both goddesses at the Harbour Bridge, unlocking Act 9.

nodes.name: Kira's Rite and Garukhan's Death
nodes.summary: The exile kills Kira and Garukhan but fails to save Oyun; the Feather goes to Tasuni or Irasha.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills Shakari
nodes.summary: Using Garukhan's bottled storm the exile clears the sandstorm and kills Shakari.

nodes.name: Entering the Beast's Belly
nodes.summary: Sin burns a new entrance into the Beast's corpse using Basilisk acid and mining powder.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills the Depraved Trinity
nodes.summary: The three harvested souls merge into the Depraved Trinity in the Rotting Core and are destroyed; Lilly then offers passage to Oriath.

nodes.name: Return to Oriath
nodes.summary: Lilly Roth ferries the exile to Oriath Docks; Lani describes Vilenta's betrayal.

nodes.name: The Exile Rescues Bannon
nodes.summary: The exile saves Bannon from Kitava's cultists on the Cathedral Rooftop.

nodes.name: Bannon Resurrects Innocence
nodes.summary: Bannon uses the Staff of Avarius and sacrifices himself to host the reborn Innocence.

nodes.name: Innocence Breaks Kitava's Horns
nodes.summary: Innocence destroys the black gates blocking the Canals.

nodes.name: The Exile Kills Kitava
nodes.summary: In the Feeding Trough, with Sin and Innocence's help, the exile kills Kitava and unlocks the Epilogue; Sin: 'you are no exile'.

nodes.name: Vilenta's Vengeance
nodes.summary: Optional: the exile kills the monstrous Vilenta in the Control Blocks.

nodes.name: Sailing Away from Oriath
nodes.summary: After Kitava's death Lilly Roth, in a class-specific line, offers to sail the exile away from Oriath and the quest 'Toward the Future' leads to the Epilogue.

nodes.name: Oriath after Kitava (older Epilogue, v3.9-3.16)
nodes.summary: Historical content (removed in 3.17): in the earlier Epilogue the exile talks to Officer Kirac in rebuilding Oriath, who asks them to investigate his brother Baran's disappearance and Zana at the Templar Laboratory, leading to the Vault of Venarius and a rebuilt Map Device. Kitava's skull is displayed in Oriath (Epilogue).

sources.locator: Gallery: Kitava's skull on display in Oriath (Epilogue)

nodes.name: Karui Shores and the Atlas of Worlds
nodes.summary: The exile reaches Karui Shores and starts mapping.

nodes.name: Divinia and the Mortinomicon
nodes.summary: Divinia asks the exile to retrieve the Mortinomicon from the Ossuary; this leads to the Forbidden Sanctum.

nodes.name: The Depraved Trinity
nodes.summary: Combined spirit of Shavronne, Maligaro and Doedre, manifested by Sin in the Rotting Core; final boss of Act 9.

nodes.name: Cultists of Kitava
nodes.summary: Followers of Kitava who plunder refugee ships fleeing Oriath, flood Oriath after its fall (Vilenta lets them into the Overseer's Tower) and hunt for food for their god; the drowned they leave behind wash ashore at the Twilight Strand.

sources.locator: Lilly: cultists have been plundering the refugee ships
Bannon: Kitava's cultists are constantly on the prowl seeking food for their god
Lani: Vilenta led the cultists into the Overseer's Tower

nodes.name: Kitava's Horns
nodes.summary: Two huge black gates in the Ravaged Square that block the way to the Canals and Kitava's Feeding Trough; impenetrable to men, they are broken by the resurrected Innocence.

sources.locator: Bannon: 'two large black gates... Kitava's Horns'

nodes.name: Sekhema Asenath
nodes.summary: Maraketh Sekhema of Sekhemas ('the Golden Sekhema') who last wore the Wings of Vastiri and was murdered by Hector Titucius.

sources.locator: Hargan: last worn by Sekhema Asenath, the Golden Sekhema

nodes.name: Veruso, Prima Imperialus
nodes.summary: Eternal Empire figure who placed the Ankh of Eternity in a Quay shrine at the dawn of the Empire; his wife Chiara was changed by it.

sources.locator: Clarissa: Veruso, Prima Imperialus, placed the Ankh; what it did to his wife Chiara

nodes.name: The Gemling Legion Rises
nodes.summary: Optional Act 8 quest: Maramoa has seen a Gemling Legion Captain gathering gemling legionnaires (once Emperor Chitus's personal swords) at the Grain Gate; the exile kills them, leaving Maramoa fearful that other Undying may regain sentience.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Maramoa on the Grain Gate

nodes.name: No Love for Old Ghosts
nodes.summary: Optional Act 10 quest: Weylam Roth sends the exile to the Ossuary for Atziri's Elixir of Allure, a love potion kept in the skull of her favourite lover, which Templars had looted.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Weylam on Queen Atziri's love potion

nodes.name: Web of Secrets
nodes.summary: Act 7 quest: Silk asks the exile to take the venom of Black Death, Maligaro's pet spider, which is killed together with Maligaro in his Sanctum; Silk's strange talk afterwards leads to the Mother of Spiders quest.

sources.locator: Intro: Silk's strange dialogue at the end of Web of Secrets
